REL-FX-1.summary: Evidence-bound COMPLETE. REPORTING -> COMPLETE (API and store.transitionMission/completeMission) only when the mission's latest run is AWAITING_APPROVAL with REPORT + CLEAN REVIEW + non-BLOCKED SECURITY_REPORT evidence whose commitSha == run.headSha (runner stepReport predicate shared via core/workos/outcomes.ts reviewAndSecurityFor). One RUN_TRANSITION journal entry carries the run AWAITING_APPROVAL -> SUCCEEDED move and the embedded mission REPORTING -> COMPLETE move plus completion evidence refs; otherwise 409 WORKOS_CONFLICT with a stable reason (COMPLETION_NO_RUN, COMPLETION_RUN_NOT_AWAITING_APPROVAL, COMPLETION_HEAD_SHA_MISSING, COMPLETION_REVIEW_EVIDENCE_MISSING, COMPLETION_SECURITY_EVIDENCE_MISSING, COMPLETION_REPORT_EVIDENCE_MISSING) and the journal unchanged. Replay re-checks the predicate (COMPLETION_UNSUPPORTED tamper). Engine write paths cannot produce SUCCEEDED or a mission move to COMPLETE (COMPLETION_REQUIRES_EVIDENCE_GUARD). Pure deriveOutcomes(run, evidence) returns execution, functionalAcceptance, security, evidenceIntegrity, recovery, release, customerOutcome with reasons; exposed read-only on GET /v1/work-runs/:id and in the COMPLETE response.

REL-FX-4.summary: Interruption recovery minimum. (a) TORN_TAIL: when journal.jsonl does not end with LF, the prefix up to the last LF must pass the full hash-chain verification and the unterminated tail must be a byte prefix of the expected next entry ({"seq":lastSeq+1,"prevHash":"<lastHash>","type":"); then the store opens read-only (reads from the verified prefix, writes refused with WORKOS_READ_ONLY JOURNAL_TORN_TAIL -> HTTP 503), writes nothing (no snapshot) except a byte-exact quarantine copy dataDir/quarantine/journal-torn-<fileSha256[0:16]>.jsonl. Anything else (corrupt prefix, foreign tail, snapshot ahead) stays tamper/fail-closed (JOURNAL_TRUNCATED_LINE etc.). Status is visible on the existing GET /v1/control/status as workos {state OK|ABSENT|TORN_TAIL|TAMPERED|UNAVAILABLE, reason, tornTail}. Truncation only through POST /v1/system/workos/journal/repair-torn-tail behind the per-launch control token (x-uasco-control-token) and the normal write gate, with body {confirmTailSha256} equal to the tail sha256; the store re-reads under the journal lock, verifies the whole-file hash and the quarantine copy, writes a .repair.json record next to the copy, truncates, reloads; tamper is never truncated. (b) DISK_FULL: append goes through an fs seam (WorkOsStoreOptions.io.writeSync, test injection only; BuildServerOptions.workosStoreOptions); on ENOSPC/EDQUOT/short write the file is truncated back to its pre-write size via a separate r+ handle (Windows append handles cannot truncate) and WORKOS_DISK_FULL is thrown (HTTP 507); state is not applied, no partial line. Snapshot writes are best-effort (derived file). (c) PROVIDER_QUOTA: failing implementer/reviewer output (last 8 KiB of the executor log) is classified with the master automation/lib/failure-classifier.mjs (present on this lineage, imported unchanged); QUOTA_EXHAUSTED or RATE_LIMIT -> run BLOCKED with reason PROVIDER_QUOTA (mission BLOCKED), retryCount unchanged, evidence note PROVIDER_LIMIT: <class>.

REL-FX-2.summary: Test-surface guard (first slice of the independent oracle). In VERIFY, in the run's fresh scan clone, git diff --name-status -z --find-renames base..head (empty attributes, no textconv/ext-diff) is classified against fixed test globs (tests/**, test/**, **/__tests__/**, **/*.test.*, **/*.spec.*, **/*_test.*, **/test_*.py, **/test.{js,mjs,cjs,ts}) plus the relative file arguments of the mission/project testCommand. Added / modified / deleted / renamed test paths, assertion-count drop (master change-guard assertionCount idea: expect/assert/assert.<m>/assertEquals/assertTrue/assertFalse calls) and newly added .skip/.only are recorded with the parsed executed-test count (vitest, jest, node:test TAP, pytest, cargo, dotnet, mocha; null when unrecognised) in a TEST_SURFACE evidence item (commitSha=headSha). functionalAcceptance: deleted test (including a rename out of the test globs) or weakened test -> BLOCKED; zero executed tests or a newly added test file without assertions -> UNVERIFIED_VACUOUS; any other touched test without a mission-pinned oracle -> UNVERIFIED_ORACLE; untouched -> UNKNOWN. VERIFIED is never produced in this slice (no pinned oracle). The list is passed to the independent reviewer (MissionSpec.testSurface + prompt section) and noted in the REVIEW evidence (TEST_SURFACE_GIVEN) and report.json. deriveOutcomes reads functionalAcceptance from the TEST_SURFACE evidence for run.headSha, and the FX-1 COMPLETE guard refuses with COMPLETION_FUNCTIONAL_ACCEPTANCE_BLOCKED when it is BLOCKED (wired in completionEvidence, also enforced on replay). The run itself still proceeds to AWAITING_APPROVAL so the reviewer and Founder see the truthful outcome.

RV-RELFX-C2-002.fix: New parseTestRunStreams(stdout, stderr): each stream is parsed separately by runner convention (vitest, node:test TAP/spec, pytest, cargo, dotnet, mocha on stdout; jest on stderr; zero-test markers on either). Within one stream, the single-summary runners (vitest Tests line, jest Tests: line, TAP counters, pytest final line, mocha passing/failing/pending) must not have different-content duplicates; a conflict -> null. A stream that is recognised but unreadable/conflicting -> null (no fallback to the other stream); two streams with different summaries -> null. null -> UNKNOWN (EXECUTED_TEST_COUNT_UNPARSEABLE), never executed. parseTestRunSummary(output, stream = 'any') keeps the single-text API (concatenated text with two different vitest summaries is now null, not the last one). core/workos/runner.ts VERIFY uses parseTestRunStreams(r.stdout, r.stderr) instead of parsing the concatenation.
